Subject: SIG follow-up: access controls slices (SCIM / SAML / RBAC / MFA)

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for taking this on. We're working through your SIG and flagged a handful of items we need evidence for to close the access controls section:

- SAML metadata and a sample IdP configuration (we use Okta)
- SCIM schema support and an attribute->Redwood mapping (groups, title, manager)
- RBAC model: canonical role list and default privileges (least-privilege guidance)
- MFA enforcement: where it's configured and (ideally) a screenshot or link to a policy
- Admin audit logs for the last 90 days (redacted is fine)

I've attached the partial SIG spreadsheet our vendor security team started (sparkpay_sig_partial.xlsx) — see columns labeled "RequestedEvidence" and "RequestedFormat."

Can you confirm what you can provide and a target delivery date? We're aiming to complete our review by June 21.

Appreciate it —
Jacob
Security Engineering
SparkPay Inc.

Jacob — thanks for the clear list and the spreadsheet. We can supply the artifacts you listed. High-level plan:

- SAML metadata (XML) + brief Okta config notes: will provide redwood_saml_metadata.xml and a short checklist.
- SCIM: we will generate an attribute mapping CSV and a short note about group handling (we map SCIM groups -> role assignments).
- RBAC: canonical role set (Admin / Engineer / App-Editor / Viewer), default privileges and least-privilege recommendations in a one-page PDF.
- MFA: screenshot of our org policy and the enforcement date; we enforce MFA via Okta at org-level.
- Audit logs: last 90 days exported and redacted to remove user emails of external contractors — will provide a redacted CSV and sample console screenshot.

Target: initial package by Wednesday, June 16 COB PT. If you need anything earlier (e.g., SAML metadata to test with Okta), let me know and I can send the XML today.

I'll loop in our infra/compliance engineers to prepare the artifacts.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Naomi / team / Jacob — attaching the initial package for review. Items included:

- redwood_saml_metadata.xml (SAML metadata; entityID and ACS values verified against our test Okta tenant)
- saml_setup_notes.md (short checklist: required attributes: email, givenName, familyName, groups)
- scim_attribute_mapping.csv (mapping: userName->email, displayName->name, groups->roles)
- RBAC_roles_v1.pdf (Admin, Engineer, App-Editor, Viewer + least-privilege defaults)
- Audit_Screenshot.png (console capture showing "MFA enforcement = ON" under Org Settings)
- Logs_redacted.csv (admin actions, redacted user identifiers)

Notes on provisioning and least privilege:
- Default role for new SCIM-provisioned users = Viewer. Group membership provisioning is used to grant Editor/App-Editor privileges.
- Service accounts are created via a request workflow and are assigned the "Service" role with scoped privileges; they require an owner and periodic revalidation.
- MFA is enforced at the org level via Okta; conditional access is used for remote access exceptions (documented in saml_setup_notes.md).

Link to artifacts (internal drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRedwood/SparkPay_SIG

Jacob — if this looks good I can upload a pared-down ZIP and send to you directly. Grace / Priyom — flag any missing items; otherwise I'll bundle everything by EOD and Naomi can send onward.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
